newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 5.

text.p: These were the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Three suspects in the Nalanda Ellawala killing identified during a witness parade in Ratnapura in central Sri Lanka on Tuesday. Ellawala, a ruling coalition legislator was gunned down last month.
Elections Commissioner instructs government departments not to release official vehicles for work related to the March 21 local government polls.
President Kumaratunga calls on government doctors not to go ahead with their proposed strike over a salary dispute.
Deadline for handing over illegal firearms extended to March 15.
Elections Commissioner permits candidates in March polls to use private television channels for party political boradcassts.
